title: Let users change their display name
description: Adds PATCH /api/users/me with a new `name`, trimmed, from 1 to 100 characters. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: `it.only` was left in, so Vitest runs only this test in the file and silently skips the empty-name, long-name and anonymous tests (and in CI, where `allowOnly` is off, the run fails).
